summary: Rocket.Chat is a self-hostable team chat / omnichannel messaging server (Meteor + MongoDB). Persisted business entities: Users, Rooms, Messages, Subscriptions, Roles, Permissions, Settings, Teams, Invites, Integrations, and a large livechat (omnichannel) set (visitors, departments, inquiries, contacts, triggers, custom fields, priorities, SLA), plus uploads, emoji/custom-sounds/user-statuses, video conferences, calendar events, moderation reports, push tokens, oauth apps, webdav accounts, banners, NPS and import operations.

_no_edges.why: public livechat/visitor registration endpoint (authRequired:false); only non-empty-token validation, no auth middleware and no precondition — the only call is internal registerGuest. Looked at api/v1/omnichannel/visitor.ts:17-70.
Public op (authRequired:false). No permission wall; only format/availability checks (username in use, email exists, name chars) and settings rate limiter. Looked at users.ts:895-963.

Public op (authRequired:false). Only gated by Accounts_PasswordReset setting; looks up user by email and sends reset email. No permission guard. Looked at users.ts:1164-1199 and meteor-methods/auth/sendForgotPasswordEmail.ts:18-39.

Self/token-scoped (authRequired:true), operates only on this.user; no permission requirement and no cross-user target. Looked at users.ts:1614-1652 and meteor-methods/platform/requestDataDownload.ts:26-110.
authRequired only; sets own subscription open/close, no permission wall (channels.ts open/close routes)
authRequired only; sets own subscription open/close, no permission wall (channels.ts open/close routes)

Self-service: teams.leave removes only the calling user (Team.removeMembers(this.userId, team._id, [{userId:this.userId}])). No permission check, only authRequired and team existence. Service removeMembers guards last remaining owner (removeMembers API, service.ts:803) but there is no Permission edge. teams.ts:657-687

Public token-gated op: useInviteToken requires only a valid invite token and an authenticated user; gated by validateInviteToken + room INVITE member action check, no permission check. useInviteToken.ts:10-32, invites.ts:251-254
Fully public: livechat/offline.message has no authRequired and no permission or token check, only a rate limiter (1 per 5s). offlineMessage.ts:7-24
push.token POST is authRequired only; requires x-auth-token header (inherent to API auth) but no permission or ownership wall — token stored with userId=this.userId for the caller. api/v1/push.ts:165
banners.dismiss is authRequired only, no permissionsRequired and no per-banner ownership check; calls Banner.dismiss(userId,bannerId). api/v1/banners.ts:187-204
calendar-events.create is authRequired only; event created with uid=this.userId (self-scoped) with no permission/ownership rejection wall. api/v1/calendar.ts:102-131

addWebdavAccount meteor method gates only on login + Webdav_Integration_Enabled workspace setting (no per-user permission/ownership wall; account tied to own userId). bridges/webdav/methods/addWebdavAccount.ts:88
